_last_verified: 2026-09-16 - every figure below checked against its official source on this date. An unchanged number is a CONFIRMED number, not a forgotten one: record the check here even when nothing moves, so the next person can tell the difference.
_release_calendar: NBS publishes the CPI report mid-month for the previous month (August 2026 CPI was released 15 Sep 2026). The CBN MPC meets roughly every two months; the 306th met 20-21 Jul 2026 and the 307th is scheduled for 21-22 Sep 2026. Check within a few days of each.
_how_to_update: Edit the numbers below when new official data is released, then commit and push - the site redeploys itself. 'value' must be a plain number (no % or naira sign); prefix/suffix are added automatically. IMPORTANT: an item only appears on the site when "publish": true AND it has a value. Leave an item unpublished until you have checked the figure against the official source named in 'source'. Never publish a rate you have not verified - this site is a regulated firm's publication.
